description: Find Romanian companies by the name of a director or legal representative (ONRC). Diacritic-insensitive. Whole words: 'pop maria' finds POP MARIA, not POPA MARIANA; prefix=true matches prefixes. The registry has no personal ID, so one name can be several people: homonyms and byCounty say so. Use this when you know a person rather than a company.

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

max_results.description: Maximum number of companies to return (1-100, default 10).
max_results.title: Max Results

name.description: Director / representative name to search for (e.g. 'Ion Popescu'); diacritic-insensitive, each word a whole word of the name.
name.title: Name

prefix.description: true matches each word as a prefix ('pop' also finds POPA, POPESCU); default false (whole words).
prefix.title: Prefix

name: lookup_director

outputSchema.description: Companies where a person with this name is director or representative.

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

distinctCounties.description: Number of counties the matches are in.

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

fields.description: The company fields kept when fields or compact trimmed the rows.

homonyms.description: true when the matches span several counties (likely several people).

note.description: What homonyms means for this name.

items.description: A company record: companyName, cui, registrationCode, registrationDate (DD/MM/YYYY), legalForm, euid, address (a sole trader's PFA/II/IF locality only in an answer listing several companies, with addressScope: locality), county, city, website, phone as declared (+ phoneSource: ANAF, declared by the taxpayer; phoneStatus: valid, corrected with phoneSuggestion, or unverified: check before calling), caenActivities [{code, activity (RO), activityEn}], directors, representatives [{name, role}], status [{code, name}], latestFinancials {year, revenue, netResult, employees; RON}, anaf {mainCaen, vatPayer, eFactura, inactive}, risk {level, label, reasons, isLead}, source, asOf, url (the company's public record page to share with the user; null for sole traders and other natural persons), and score/match on name searches. With fields or compact, only the requested keys (compact keeps url).

returned.description: Rows in results. Every list answer carries it with this one meaning.

source.description: Data source: onrc (registry) or mfp (Ministry of Finance filings).

total.description: Every matching company, not just the rows returned.

totalIsLowerBound.description: true when the scan stopped early and total is a minimum.

warnings.description: Notes on how the request was read (a clamped limit, a widened CAEN code, an ignored field).

title: Find companies by director
